title: Irreversible Local PII Redaction
script: Welcome to this deep dive into Irreversible Local PII Redaction. Part of PaperPilot's native Privacy & Security suite, this tool provides deterministic, local-first execution. Engineered entirely in pure Rust, it operates with zero cloud egress, giving you complete data privacy, no SaaS subscription fees, and no external API rate limits. Now let us examine the input parameters and what each signifies. You configure input, an required parameter for Path to the input PDF file.. In addition, page, an optional parameter for 1-based page number when redacting a rectangular box (default 1).. In addition, x, an optional parameter for Lower-left X coordinate of redaction box in points.. In addition, y, an optional parameter for Lower-left Y coordinate of redaction box in points.. In addition, width, an optional parameter for Redaction box width in points (default 100).. In addition, height, an optional parameter for Redaction box height in points (default 100).. In addition, rect, an optional parameter for Alternative box as 'x,y,width,height' or 4-element number array.. In addition, query, an optional parameter for Literal keyword or phrase to redact permanently.. In addition, regex, an optional parameter for Regular expression pattern to match and redact.. In addition, patterns, an optional parameter for List of literal strings to match and redact.. In addition, rules, an optional parameter for Structured array of RedactRule objects for multi-rule redaction.. In addition, case_sensitive, an optional parameter for Enable case-sensitive text/regex matching (default false).. In addition, overlay_text, an optional parameter for Optional replacement label printed on blackout boxes (for example, '[REDACTED]').. In addition, occurrence, an optional parameter for Occurrence filter: 'all' (default), 'first', 'last', or comma-separated 1-based indices.. Every parameter is rigorously validated in memory before processing begins, ensuring safe, predictable transformations across all your documents. Next, output files and metrics. The tool emits optimized .pdf documents at Destination path for the redacted .pdf file.. By pruning redundant objects, deduplicating font streams, and applying memory-safe Rayon parallelism, it slashes document file size by up to eighty percent in under fifteen milliseconds, with zero bytes leaked to the cloud. You can deploy pdf_redact across all five universal interfaces. First, drag and drop in the desktop dock for live inspection. Second, call it autonomously from Claude or AI agents through our native Model Context Protocol server. Third, run it directly in your terminal with the PaperPilot CLI. Fourth, trigger it via local REST API POST requests at localhost port 8080. And fifth, execute it client-side in your browser with zero-upload WebAssembly. Unlock total document privacy and native performance today. Visit usepaperpilot.com to explore pdf_redact and all one hundred tools, run live interactive benchmarks, and download the bare-metal binary. Local-first document intelligence, powered by PaperPilot.
